龙国篇龙国篇第十一章烈阳天道下
叶恒的目光穿透重重烈焰，凝视着那片已被熊熊火海无情吞噬的艾露之地，他的面庞上悄然浮现出一抹久违的胜利曙光与难以掩饰的喜悦。
“这招烈阳.天道虽是我所悟出的武神器技，但如此强大且消耗巨多武神力的武神器技确这一直以来所使用过的两次，这一次还好，没有像第一次那样，使完之后就筋疲力尽那种。”
“极大可能是因为武神等级的提升所带来的增议效果，若是我如今是A级武神的话这招或许能使4到5次这样吧！”
“同样的，到了A级武神那我的武神技便又再多两个武神技。
丽莎姐说过，每一位武神到了S级武神，武神命器技便增加到5个，也就是说，B级一个，A级三个，而到了S级是五个”
火焰的狂潮曾如怒龙般肆虐，席卷一切，却也转瞬即逝，最终只留下满目疮痍与零星的火星，在灰烬中苟延残喘。
在这片死寂之中，一道身影静默如石，屹立于废墟之上，引得叶恒心头猛地一紧，惊呼脱口而出：“这……怎么可能！
她竟还未陨落！”
随着最后一丝火焰的消散，艾露的真容缓缓展露，她的面庞上挂着几抹未干的血迹，却更显坚毅与不屈。
她轻轻一抹嘴角，那份从容与淡然，仿佛刚刚经历的不是生死较量，而是一场微不足道的试炼。
几乎是在同一瞬间，艾露身形化作一道流光，倏忽间已至叶恒身后，其速度之快，连空气中都未留下丝毫痕迹，令叶恒连其气息都捕捉不到，只能愕然以对。
“区区B级武神，竟也敢蚍蜉撼树，挑战S级武神的威严。”
艾露的声音清冷而威严，每一个字都仿佛重锤，敲击在叶恒的心头。
话音未落，她双手轻扬，周身顿时涌动起一股恐怖的能量波动，那是属于她，S级武神独有的力量——“红莲·业火”
只见火焰在她掌心汇聚，化作一片绚烂而致命的火海，仿佛能吞噬世间一切罪孽与生机，向着叶恒及周遭的一切汹涌而去。
艾露：“在我的业火面前，如何人的欲望会在我的火海中无限扩大，直至烧尽”
艾露：“就让我瞧一瞧，你是否配得上‘光明之子’之称”
火光再次围住叶恒，他的身躯在火光的映照下显得异常单薄，却透出一股子令人敬畏的坚韧。
衣衫虽已破败不堪，多处被利刃划破，血迹斑斑，与泥土混杂在一起，确见证了他一路走来的艰辛与战斗。

然而，正是这样一具看似摇摇欲坠的身躯，凭借着手中紧握的那柄长剑，依然屹立不倒，宛如一座不可撼动的丰碑。
“罪恶？哈哈哈哈……”
叶恒的笑声在夜空中回荡，带着几分悲凉，几分愤慨。
他的声音沙哑而有力，每一个字都像是从心底最深处迸发而出，“我有什么错？我追求的，不过是让这乱世之中，那些无辜的百姓能够有一个避风的港湾，一个可以称之为家的地方。
而那些真正该万死的人，是你们这些制造战乱、让无辜者流离失所、家破人亡的你们！”
“我虽贪玩，但并不代表我不学无术，虽他人说我天赋过人，但我不怎么认为，若我真有那等上天赐予的才华，又怎会在星辰寂寥之时，他人沉浸梦乡之际，独自挑灯，奋力耕耘于武道的巅峰上？”
“我漫步于人生的长廊，记忆深处，一幅是宁静祥和的田园风光，人们在参天大树的庇护下悠然自得，孩童们围坐一圈，分享着父母亲手烹制的烤鱼，那香味似乎能穿越时空，混合着新鲜果汁的甘甜，他们笑声朗朗，无忧无虑地编织着属于童年的梦幻故事。
这画面，温暖而明媚，如同世间最温柔的笔触，勾勒出生活的甜蜜与纯真。”
“然而，转角之处，却是另一番景象，残酷而令人心痛。
我亲眼目睹了烈焰如何无情地吞噬了宁静，那些本该在阳光下奔跑嬉戏的孩子，却在大火的肆虐下失去了所有的庇护与欢笑。
那一刻，火光映照着他们惊恐无助的脸庞，成为了我心中永远无法抹去的烙印。
这对比鲜明的画面，如同命运的双面镜，映照出生活的美好与残酷，也在我心中种下了更加坚定的信念——珍惜每一刻，不懈追求，以知识为盾，以勇气为剑，守护那些值得守护的美好。”
艾露愣了愣有点不敢相信叶恒会讲出这样的话，但经过仔细想想，他被称为‘光明之子’也不是没有理由。
艾露：“你有此觉悟我很欣慰，但没有实力你又如何去改变这个乱世？”
叶恒：““我辈当万死不辞，岂能尽如人意，但求无愧我心”
content_en:
Dragon Kingdom Chapter Dragon Kingdom Chapter 11 Under the Burning Sun Heavenly Way
Ye Heng's eyes penetrated the heavy flames and stared at the land of Ellu that had been mercilessly swallowed up by the raging sea of fire. A long-lost glimmer of victory and unconcealable joy quietly appeared on his face.
"Although this move of Lieyang and Heaven is a martial arts weapon skill that I have realized, it is such a powerful martial arts weapon skill that consumes a huge amount of martial arts power. This is the only time I have used it twice. This time it was okay. It was not like the first time where I was exhausted after using it."
"It's most likely because of the increased discussion effect brought about by the improvement of the Martial God's level. If I were an A-level Martial God now, I might be able to use this trick 4 to 5 times!"
"Similarly, when I reach the A-level Martial God, my Martial God skills will have two more Martial God skills.
Sister Lisa said that when every Martial God reaches S-level Martial God, the Martial God’s life weapon skills increase to 5, that is to say, one for B-level, three for A-level, and five for S-level.”
The craze of flames once raged like an angry dragon, sweeping everything, but it also passed away in an instant, leaving only devastation and scattered sparks lingering in the ashes.
In this dead silence, a figure stood as silent as a stone on the ruins, causing Ye Heng's heart to tighten suddenly, and he blurted out in surprise: "This... how is it possible!
She hasn't fallen yet! "
As the last trace of flames dissipated, Ellu's true appearance was slowly revealed. There were a few traces of wet blood on her face, but she showed even more perseverance and unyieldingness.
She lightly touched the corner of her mouth, with that calmness and indifference, as if what she had just experienced was not a battle of life and death, but an insignificant trial.
Almost at the same moment, Ai Lu's figure turned into a stream of light, and suddenly she was behind Ye Heng. Her speed was so fast that she didn't even leave any traces in the air. Ye Heng couldn't even catch his breath, so he could only react in shock.
"A mere B-level Martial God actually dares to challenge the majesty of an S-level Martial God."
Ai Lu's voice was cold and majestic, and every word was like a heavy hammer hitting Ye Heng's heart.
Before she finished speaking, she raised her hands slightly, and a terrifying wave of energy suddenly surged around her body. It belonged to her, the unique power of the S-class Martial God - "Red Lotus·Yehuo"
The flames gathered in her palms and turned into a gorgeous and deadly sea of fire, which seemed to be able to swallow up all the sins and vitality in the world, rushing towards Ye Heng and everything around him.
Ellu: "In front of my karmic fire, no one's desires will expand infinitely in my sea of fire until they are burned out."
Elu: "Let me see if you are worthy of the title of 'Son of Light'"
The firelight once again surrounded Ye Heng. His body looked extremely thin under the firelight, but revealed an awe-inspiring tenacity.
Although his clothes were in tatters, with many cuts by sharp knives, and stains of blood mixed with the soil, they were indeed witnesses of the hardships and battles he had endured along the way.
However, it is such a seemingly shaky body that still stands firm with the long sword in its hand, like an unshakable monument.
"Sin? Hahahaha..."
Ye Heng's laughter echoed in the night sky, with a bit of sadness and anger.
His voice was hoarse and powerful, and every word seemed to burst out from the deepest part of his heart, "What's wrong with me? What I pursue is just to allow those innocent people in this troubled world to have a haven and a place to call home.
And those who really deserve death are you who create wars, displace innocent people, and destroy your families! "
"Although I am playful, it does not mean that I am uneducated. Although others say that I have extraordinary talents, I don't think so. If I really have the talents that God has given me, how can I pick up the lamp alone and work hard to reach the pinnacle of martial arts when the stars are lonely and others are immersed in their dreams?"
"I am walking along the corridor of life, deep in my memory, a picture of a quiet and peaceful pastoral scene, where people are leisurely and contented under the protection of towering trees. Children sit in a circle and share grilled fish cooked by their parents. The fragrance seems to travel through time and space, mixed with the sweetness of fresh juice. They laugh loudly and weave dreamy stories of childhood carefree.
This picture is warm and bright, like the gentlest brushstrokes in the world, outlining the sweetness and innocence of life. "
“However, around the corner, there was a different scene, cruel and heart-wrenching.
I witnessed with my own eyes how the flames mercilessly devoured the tranquility. The children who were supposed to be running and playing in the sun lost all their shelter and laughter under the raging fire.
At that moment, the firelight illuminated their frightened and helpless faces, which became a mark in my heart that can never be erased.
This contrasting picture is like a double-sided mirror of fate, reflecting the beauty and cruelty of life. It also planted a firmer belief in my heart - cherish every moment, pursue unremittingly, use knowledge as a shield and courage as a sword to protect the beauty worth protecting. "
Ai Lu was stunned for a moment and couldn't believe that Ye Heng would say such a thing, but after thinking about it carefully, it was not without reason that he was called the 'Son of Light'.
Elu: "I'm very happy that you have this awareness, but how can you change this troubled world without the strength? "
Ye Heng: "I will never give up even if I die. How can I live up to everyone's expectations? I just want to live up to my heart."
